text.description_html:
Acorn IMBBP, Sonoma Iron Door Knocker

Hand forged, the Sonoma Iron Door Knocker is a modern day reminder of the times of old. Brilliantly hand crafted, this door knocker made by Acorn, will be sure to add a historic feel to any door. It may look like it comes straight from another century, but it is made to last; it has a lifetime no rust warranty. The uneven surface of this iron piece duplicates that found on the ironwork of many European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Created by using the techniques of the traditional forge, each piece is fabricated with a rare craftmanship, reminiscent of a time when expert anvil artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into beautiful yet functional designs.

Specifications of the Sonoma Iron Door Knocker:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Ring Height: 5-1/8"
  • Ring Width: 5-1/3"
  • Overall Height: 6"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Includes 5/8" Knocker Nail
  • Surface Mounted with Included Screws
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Due to the handmade nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
